messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — ThetaFoods (trial) shows a 30% dip in API usage this week, onboarding stalled at schema mapping. Can we spin a short rescue/resuscitation flow to run today? @Elena can you join?
Elena (AM): Yep — I can. Thinking a 3-step micro-flow: 1) 30-min triage call w/ eng + customer, 2) deliver 1-page mapping snippet + quick video, 3) offer a small adoption incentive (credit or 1:1 session). Which incentive should we default to? :thinking_face:
Samir (CSE): If schema mapping is the blocker, I can do a pairing session. Quick sample mapping we can hand them during the call: ```yaml
input_fields:
  - name: sku
    map_to: product_id
  - name: qty
    map_to: quantity
transforms:
  - name: trim_spaces
    fields: [sku]
```
Ravi (Support): I dug into recent logs — we have intermittent 401s from their IP range starting 3/12. Opened ticket #4532 and flagged it to infra. I can attach the error snippets to the triage doc.
Maya (CSM): Nice. For the incentive: propose default = 30% credit for first 2 months OR one free 90-min onboarding pairing (engineer + CSM). Elena, can you pick and own outreach? I'll book the triage call for 3pm PT.
Elena (AM): I’ll own outreach and offer selection. I lean toward the free pairing first (higher chance of adoption), fallback to credit if they decline. Draft outreach copy: "Quick 30-min session to finish schema + free pairing if needed" — will post to thread before sending.
Samir (CSE): I'll prepare a 2-slide mapping cheat sheet + a tiny repo example. If they accept pairing, I can do a 90-min session within 48 hours.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: ThetaFoods triage — 2024-03-15 15:00 PT. Invite sent to theta@thetacorp.com and internal owners.
Maya (CSM): OK next steps: Elena sends outreach + picks incentive, Samir readies cheat sheet, Ravi attaches logs to ticket #4532, I’ll run the call at 3pm PT. After call we convert this into a 1-paragraph playbook entry and attach to the retention playbook board (JIRA-RET-889).
Elena (AM): Copy — I’ll post outreach copy here in 10m and ping once sent. Adding a quick success metric: convert to active usage (>= baseline calls) within 7 days or we escalate to renew-engagement plan. :white_check_mark:
